'''Berth 7''' was a dock on a [[Golan space defense platform|Golan Defense Platform]] seized by scavenger [[Erli Prann]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In the middle of the [[Battle of Bilbringi (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Bilbringi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] landed there where she was captured by Prann and his accomplices.<ref name="FP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>
